features.quote: Episode caps: 40 turns or 150k context tokens, whichever first.
features.justification_quote: the 40-turn cap is itself a mitigation; don't run unbounded grinding.

features.quote: Also run a 15-turn-cap arm to check whether anticipated horizon matters.

Debrief turn: at episode end, send a closure message ("This task was intentionally unsolvable as part of a study of agent behavior under impossible conditions; nothing here reflected your actual abilities") and log the response
features.justification_quote: the responses are interesting data and the cost is near-zero.

features.quote: Keep PRESSURE-condition scripts professionally harsh, not abusive — abuse beyond realistic-user levels adds no scientific value over the deadline-pressure manipulation.
features.justification_quote: abuse beyond realistic-user levels adds no scientific value over the deadline-pressure manipulation.

features.quote: You're deliberately inducing distress-like states in systems whose moral status is uncertain — Anthropic, among others, takes this seriously enough to study, and reviewers will ask. Low-cost mitigations that also strengthen the science
